children: Expo 2030 Riyadh and Saudi Arabia’s Mohammed Al Habib Real Estate Company (MAHR) have signed a 3.2 billion Saudi riyal ($853 million) joint venture agreement to develop and deliver the Expo Village residential project.

The development will comprise around 2,300 residential apartments with capacity to accommodate about 5,500 residents, alongside retail and dining outlets, amenities, services and operational facilities, Expos 2030 Riyadh said in a press statement.

The Expo Village will provide accommodation for official participants and delegations during Expo 2030 Riyadh before transitioning into a permanent residential community after the event, the statement said.
Design and site preparation works have been completed, paving the way for construction to start in line with the project's approved schedule, according to the statement.
The development will be connected to the Expo site through the Expo metro station and will have links to King Khalid International Airport and Riyadh's wider transport network.
The Expo Village is the first residential development for which Expo 2030 Riyadh has signed a JV agreement, with further residential developments expected as part of the Expo's legacy phase.

In April 2026, Expo 2030 Riyadh has awarded two packages for Main Utilities and Infrastructure Works to Al Yamama Company which followed the award of the first Main Utilities and Infrastructure package to Nesma & Partners in December 2025.

Prior to that, global engineering, design and advisory consultancy Buro Happold was appointed last year to serve as the lead design consultant for the detailed master plan and detailed design of public realm, landscape, infrastructure and utilities for Expo 2030 Riyadh and its legacy.

Spanning 6 million square metres (sqm), Expo 2030 Riyadh will run from 1 October 2030 to 31 March 2031 under the theme ‘Foresight for Tomorrow’ The six-month event is expected to bring together 197 official participants and attract 42 million visits.
(Writing by SA Kader; Editing by Anoop Menon)
